import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    nz=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x]
    rs=[p[0] for p in nz]; cs=[p[1] for p in nz]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    bcolor=max(set(g[i][j] for i,j in nz), key=lambda c:sum(g[i][j]==c for i,j in nz))
    icolor=[g[i][j] for i,j in nz if g[i][j]!=bcolor][0]
    r0-=2; r1+=2; c0-=2; c1+=2
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(max(0,r0), min(h,r1+1)):
        for j in range(max(0,c0), min(w,c1+1)):
            if g[i][j]!=bcolor: res[i][j]=icolor
    return res
res=f(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(res))

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]]
    rs=[p[0] for p in nz]; cs=[p[1] for p in nz]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    cnt=Counter(g[i][j] for i,j in nz)
    bcolor=max(cnt,key=cnt.get); icolor=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if c!=bcolor][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(max(0,r0-1),min(h,r1+2)):
        for j in range(max(0,c0-1),min(w,c1+2)):
            if g[i][j]==0: res[i][j]=icolor
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    nz=[(p,q) for p in range(h) for q in range(w) if g[p][q]]
    r0=min(p for p,_ in nz); r1=max(p for p,_ in nz)
    c0=min(q for _,q in nz); c1=max(q for _,q in nz)
    cnt=Counter(g[p][q] for p in range(h) for q in range(w) if g[p][q])
    # core color = least frequent nonzero color
    fill=min(cnt,key=cnt.get)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    i=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    diffs=[(p,q,i[p][q],o[p][q]) for p in range(len(i)) for q in range(len(i[0])) if i[p][q]!=o[p][q]]
    nz_in=[(p,q) for p in range(len(i)) for q in range(len(i[0])) if i[p][q]!=0]
    nz_out=[(p,q) for p in range(len(o)) for q in range(len(o[0])) if o[p][q]!=0]
    # translation test: can out's nonzero cells be obtained by translating in's nonzero cells by (dr,dc)?
    best=max(((sum((p-dr,q-dc) in nz_in for p,q in nz_out if o[p][q]==i[p-dr][q-dc])),dr,dc) for dr in range(-len(i),len(i)+1) for dc in range(-len(i[0]),len(i[0])+1)))
    print(k,'best translate score',best[0],'/',len(nz_in),'shift',(best[1],best[2]),'num_changed',len(diffs))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    ih,iw=len(g),len(g[0])
    nz=[(p,q) for p in range(ih) for q in range(iw) if g[p][q]!=0]
    r0=min(p for p,_ in nz); r1=max(p for p,_ in nz)
    c0=min(q for _,q in nz); c1=max(q for _,q in nz)
    cnt=Counter(g[p][q] for p,q in nz)
    # fill = least frequent nonzero color (the inner/core color)
    fill=min(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    core=[(p,q) for p,q in nz if g[p][q]==fill]
    ch=max(p for p,_ in core)-min(p for p,_ in core)+1
    cw=max(q for _,q in core)-min(q for _,q in core)+1
    if ch==cw: t=ch
    else: t=ch//2
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for p in range(max(0,r0-t),min(ih,r1+t+1)):
        for q in range(max(0,c0-t),min(iw,c1+t+1)):
            if res[p][q]==0: res[p][q]=fill
    return res
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
